limitations: Applies to labelled simple prisms with n >= 5 and ordinary black-only minimum forcing sets; unresolved historical priority and no independent audit.
scientific_integrity: Earlier prism zero-forcing number 4 is credited to Alameda et al.; only the complete minimum-set multiplicity and orbit classification are presented as new. This is a self-review, not independent validation.
title: Five symmetry classes of minimum zero-forcing sets in cycle prisms
